name: Laura's Laundramutt Grooming LLC
tagline: Fresh Pups, Happy Tails, Real People.
brandNarrative:
Laura's Laundramutt Grooming isn't your average clip-and-go operation. Tucked into Salem's south side, this grooming shop has quietly built a loyal following of dog owners who keep coming back — not just because the prices are fair, but because their dogs actually like it here. Groomers like Ariel and Carol treat every dog as a regular, texting owners updates mid-appointment and accommodating everything from standard poodle styling to deshedding a pomsky without tacking on surprise fees. When a customer notes that their two 70-pound dogs have been coming here 'for years' and that 'the dogs like her,' that's not a transaction — that's a relationship.

The shop offers something increasingly rare in the grooming world: transparency and warmth at the same time. Customers rave about competitive pricing, quick appointment availability, and the kind of results that make you stop and look twice at your own dog. Whether it's a full groom on a long-haired large breed or a quick deshed add-on, the team here doesn't nickel-and-dime you — and that consistency has earned them a 4.7-star rating across 125 reviews.

But Laundramutt isn't only for the full-service crowd. Their self-serve wash stations have their own devoted fans — owners who want to handle bath time themselves with professional-grade tubs, hoses, and soap machines that actually work. One flat rate for dogs over 15 pounds? That kind of straightforward pricing signals something bigger: this is a place run by people who genuinely want dog owners to succeed, however they choose to show up.
ownerStory:
The name says it all: Laundramutt. It's playful, a little cheeky, and completely unpretentious — which is exactly the spirit Laura brought to 1705 25th St SE when she built this grooming space from the ground up. Laura's vision wasn't to create a luxury spa with a waitlist six weeks long. It was to make professional dog grooming and self-serve bathing genuinely accessible to Salem pet owners, without the sticker shock or the attitude. The result is a shop where groomers like Ariel and Carol feel empowered to build real relationships with their four-legged clients — texting owners updates, accommodating special requests, and remembering that every dog has its own personality.

The business has even grown through a location change without losing a single loyal customer — a testament to the trust the team has built one groom at a time. Laura's Laundramutt is the kind of neighborhood gem that doesn't need a flashy website to keep the appointments full. Word of mouth, wagging tails, and a refreshingly honest pricing model do all the work.

faq.question: How are your prices compared to other groomers in Salem?
faq.answer: Customers consistently call us one of the best-priced options in the area. We don't charge inflated fees for add-ons like deshedding, and our self-serve wash stations are a flat rate for dogs over 15 pounds regardless of size — no surprises at checkout.

faq.question: Can you groom large dogs over 70 pounds?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Our groomer Carol specializes in large breeds and has years of experience handling dogs well over 70 pounds — both long-haired and short-coated. Big dogs are welcome here.

faq.question: How do I know what's happening with my dog during their appointment?
faq.answer: Our groomers like Carol keep owners updated via text throughout the grooming session, so you're never left wondering. We treat your dog like a regular — because after a few visits, they usually are.

faq.question: Do you offer self-serve dog washing, or is it full-service only?
faq.answer: Both! We have professional self-serve bathing stations with tubs, hoses, and soap machines that are easy to use and well-maintained. One flat price covers all dogs over 15 pounds. Great for owners who want to stay hands-on.

faq.question: How quickly can I get an appointment?
faq.answer: We pride ourselves on getting new clients in quickly. Unlike some grooming salons with weeks-long waits, customers frequently mention how fast we were able to accommodate them — call us at (503) 967-6116 to check availability.

faq.question: What breeds and coat types do you work with?
faq.answer: We groom a wide range of breeds — from standard poodles and pomskies to short-haired large breeds. Whether your dog needs a precision cut, a deshedding treatment, or just a thorough bath, our groomers have the experience to handle it.
